The validator is also run against older versions to produce the comparison baseline, and the published 0.1.0 measures 167 characters against a cap of 165 ratcheted from 0.1.2. The throw fired before the receipt was assembled, so the 0.1.0 run returned no validation block at all and public-npm-install-contract.test.ts failed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading cleanConsumer)'. The gate itself was correct; applying a cap meant for the version under development to every version it measures was not, and the effect was to delete the evidence rather than to block a regression.
